paragraphs.text: 1. THE singer, O ye Waters in Vivasvan's place, shall tell your grandeur forth that is beyond compare.
paragraphs.original: प्र सु व आपो महिमानमुत्तमं कारुर्वोचाति सदने विवस्वतः ।
paragraphs.translit: pra su va āpo mahimānamuttamaṃ kārurvocāti sadane vivasvataḥ |

paragraphs.text: The Rivers have come forward triply, seven and seven. Sindhu in might surpasses all the streams that flow.
paragraphs.original: प्र सप्तसप्त त्रेधा हि चक्रमुः प्र सृत्वरीणामति सिन्धुरोजसा
paragraphs.translit: pra saptasapta tredhā hi cakramuḥ pra sṛtvarīṇāmati sindhurojasā

paragraphs.text: 2. Varuna cut the channels for thy forward course, O Sindhu, when thou rannest on to win the race.
paragraphs.original: प्र तेऽरदद्वरुणो यातवे पथः सिन्धो यद्वाजाँ अभ्यद्रवस्त्वम् ।
paragraphs.translit: pra te'radadvaruṇo yātave pathaḥ sindho yadvājām̐ abhyadravastvam |

paragraphs.text: Thou speedest o'er precipitous ridges of the earth, when thou art Lord and Leader of these moving floods.
paragraphs.original: भूम्या अधि प्रवता यासि सानुना यदेषामग्रं जगतामिरज्यसि
paragraphs.translit: bhūmyā adhi pravatā yāsi sānunā yadeṣāmagraṃ jagatāmirajyasi

paragraphs.text: 3. His roar is lifted up to heaven above the earth: he puts forth endless vigour with a flash of light.
paragraphs.original: दिवि स्वनो यतते भूम्योपर्यनन्तं शुष्ममुदियर्ति भानुना ।
paragraphs.translit: divi svano yatate bhūmyoparyanantaṃ śuṣmamudiyarti bhānunā |

paragraphs.text: Like floods of rain that fall- in thunder from the cloud, so Sindhu rushes on bellowing like a bull.
paragraphs.original: अभ्रादिव प्र स्तनयन्ति वृष्टयः सिन्धुर्यदेति वृषभो न रोरुवत्
paragraphs.translit: abhrādiva pra stanayanti vṛṣṭayaḥ sindhuryadeti vṛṣabho na roruvat

paragraphs.text: 4. Like mothers to their calves, like milch kine with their milk, so, Sindhu, unto thee the roaring rivers run.
paragraphs.original: अभि त्वा सिन्धो शिशुमिन्न मातरो वाश्रा अर्षन्ति पयसेव धेनवः ।
paragraphs.translit: abhi tvā sindho śiśuminna mātaro vāśrā arṣanti payaseva dhenavaḥ |

paragraphs.text: Thou leadest as a warrior king thine army's wings what time thou comest in the van of these swift streams.
paragraphs.original: राजेव युध्वा नयसि त्वमित्सिचौ यदासामग्रं प्रवतामिनक्षसि
paragraphs.translit: rājeva yudhvā nayasi tvamitsicau yadāsāmagraṃ pravatāminakṣasi

paragraphs.text: 5. Favour ye this my laud, O Ganga, Yamuna, O Sutudri, Parusni and Sarasvati:
paragraphs.original: इमं मे गङ्गे यमुने सरस्वति शुतुद्रि स्तोमं सचता परुष्ण्या ।
paragraphs.translit: imaṃ me gaṅge yamune sarasvati śutudri stomaṃ sacatā paruṣṇyā |

paragraphs.text: With Asikni, Vitasta, O Marudvrdha, O Arjikiya with Susoma hear my call.
6. First with Trstama thou art eager to flow forth, with Rasa, and Susartu, and with Svetya here,
paragraphs.original: तृष्टामया प्रथमं यातवे सजूः सुसर्त्वा रसया श्वेत्या त्या ।
paragraphs.translit: tṛṣṭāmayā prathamaṃ yātave sajūḥ susartvā rasayā śvetyā tyā |

paragraphs.text: With Kubha; and with these, Sindhu and Mehatnu, thou seekest in thy course Krumu and Gomati.
paragraphs.original: त्वं सिन्धो कुभया गोमतीं क्रुमुं मेहत्न्वा सरथं याभिरीयसे
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ sindho kubhayā gomatīṃ krumuṃ mehatnvā sarathaṃ yābhirīyase

paragraphs.text: 7. Flashing and whitely-gleaming in her mightiness, she moves along her ample volumes through the realms,
paragraphs.original: ऋजीत्येनी रुशती महित्वा परि ज्रयांसि भरते रजांसि ।
paragraphs.translit: ṛjītyenī ruśatī mahitvā pari jrayāṃsi bharate rajāṃsi |

paragraphs.text: Most active of the active, Sindhu unrestrained, like to a dappled mare, beautiful, fair to see.
paragraphs.original: अदब्धा सिन्धुरपसामपस्तमाश्वा न चित्रा वपुषीव दर्शता
paragraphs.translit: adabdhā sindhurapasāmapastamāśvā na citrā vapuṣīva darśatā

paragraphs.text: 8. Rich in good steeds is Sindhu, rich in cars and robes, rich in gold, nobly-fashioned, rich in ample wealth.
paragraphs.original: स्वश्वा सिन्धुः सुरथा सुवासा हिरण्ययी सुकृता वाजिनीवती ।
paragraphs.translit: svaśvā sindhuḥ surathā suvāsā hiraṇyayī sukṛtā vājinīvatī |

paragraphs.text: Blest Silamavati and young Urnavati invest themselves with raiment rich in store of sweets.
paragraphs.original: ऊर्णावती युवतिः सीलमावत्युताधि वस्ते सुभगा मधुवृधम्
paragraphs.translit: ūrṇāvatī yuvatiḥ sīlamāvatyutādhi vaste subhagā madhuvṛdham

paragraphs.text: 9. Sindhu hath yoked her car, light-rolling, drawn by steeds, and with that car shall she win booty in this fight.
paragraphs.original: सुखं रथं युयुजे सिन्धुरश्विनं तेन वाजं सनिषदस्मिन्नाजौ ।
paragraphs.translit: sukhaṃ rathaṃ yuyuje sindhuraśvinaṃ tena vājaṃ saniṣadasminnājau |

paragraphs.text: So have I praised its power, mighty and unrestrained, of independent glory, roaring as it runs.
